name: Savvly
description:
Savvly offers longevity-linked, SEC-registered investment products — built on the Savvly 80+ fund — that invests pooled contributions in a low-cost S&P 500 ETF and makes milestone cash payouts at ages 80, 85, 90, and 95, turning a longer life into a financial reward rather than a risk.

Savvly MCP lets financial advisors, planning tools, and AI agents query fund data, model projections, and compare against alternative retirement products directly, in real time, in any conversation, and without any manual lookup.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Savvly to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Savvly to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.savvly.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Savvly MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Savvly scores 88/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Savvly MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Savvly provides these MCP tools: check_savvly_eligibility, compare_savvly_vs_alternative, get_savvly_faq, get_savvly_product_info, project_retirement_with_savvly, project_savvly_lumpsum, project_savvly_monthly, and search_savvly_content.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Savvly?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Savvly in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Savvly does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Savvly is developed by Savvly. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
